title: His group at the Famous Door
summary: Roy led a group with Clyde Hart and Joe at the Famous Door, which kept them upstairs until the crowd left.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What did you do on 52nd Street? You had your own group there at the Famous Door?

Yeah. That was another one of them Gerry Cooney and Holmes things. We had a good group. We had Clyde Hart, Jimmy Regan(?) on guitar, I think Ted Sturgis (Ted made the audition, playing piano for me), and my

brother Joe... And Clyde Hart, right? No drums. Red Norvo had a group there. But what they would do, we played until people came in the place. Then they kept us upstairs, feeding us, they had a table set and fed us, and he entertained all night until everybody went home, then they called us to close the joint up. Now, I was wise to that. Shit, you know, we never got a chance to play while people were in there! You ready for that?
